note: Observed cloud dataset projected to factual fields. Description, biography and image URLs are omitted; content_hash belongs to the original full row. Source observations are historical, not current promises.
limits: Public profile details only. Videos is a count, not video records. No video downloads, posts, comments, follower lists, historical growth or account access. Exact source stats are preferred; counts_approximate is true when a rounded source counter is used. Username matching protects against unrelated profiles.
